name: vulkan-hevc-fallback
description: Add Vulkan HEVC encoding as fallback for AMD/Intel GPUs (between NVENC and libx264)
hypothesis: AMD/Intel users get HW-accelerated HEVC instead of falling back to CPU libx264

name: whisper-speech-detection
description: Use FFmpeg whisper filter in prepare stage to detect speech timestamps per video
hypothesis: Local speech timestamps give Gemini better trim guidance, improving keep_audio accuracy

name: av1-vulkan-encoder
description: Add AV1 encoding via Vulkan as a --codec av1 option
hypothesis: 30%+ smaller files than HEVC at same quality, royalty-free

name: d3d12-windows-fallback
description: Add D3D12 H.264/AV1 encoding for Windows AMD/Intel GPUs
hypothesis: Windows AMD/Intel users get HW acceleration instead of CPU fallback

name: multithreaded-cli-verify
description: Verify FFmpeg 7.0+ multi-threaded CLI gives automatic speedup on segment renders
hypothesis: Complex filter graphs (Ken Burns + color grade + overlay) run faster without code changes

name: hdr10-passthrough
description: Preserve HDR10 metadata when source videos are HDR (iPhone/GoPro)
hypothesis: HDR source material retains dynamic range instead of being crushed to SDR
